chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The means to secure high authority is breadth of chest (i.e., generosity).

key_terms.سَعَةُ الصَّدْرِ: Breadth of the chest; magnanimity, patience, and generosity

ai.seo_question: What is the primary quality required for leadership according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies 'breadth of the chest' (sahat al-sadr) as the essential instrument for leadership, emphasizing that true authority requires the psychological and spiritual capacity to endure the burdens of governance with patience and magnanimity. This concept, deeply rooted in Shia political ethics, links inner spiritual fortitude with the practical ability to manage diverse personalities and conflicts, reflecting the Imam’s own experience as a leader who balanced justice with forbearance.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 176. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The means to secure high authority is breadth of chest (i.e., generosity).
